sources.entry: Domoticz - Home Automation System that lets you monitor and configure various devices like: Lights, Switches, various sensors/meters like Temperature, Rain, Wind, UV, Electra, Gas, Water and much more. (Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 C/C++/Docker/Shell

summary.one_liner: An Android client app for the Domoticz home automation system, used to monitor and control lights, switches and sensors from a phone.
summary.what_it_does: The app connects to a Domoticz home automation server and lets you view and toggle devices such as lights and switches, and check sensor and meter readings. The README lists optional features: geofencing that triggers a switch on entering an area, NFC and QR codes linked to switches, Bluetooth-based switch toggling, beacon scanning (iBeacon/AltBeacon), and voice commands mapped to switches. It also mentions biometric lock on app open, floorplan views, multiple themes with day/night support, and Android Wear control. The README says Android Auto support is a work in progress and not on the Play Store. Domoticz itself is described as a lightweight system that can send notifications to mobile devices.
use_cases: control home lights and switches from an Android phone
monitor home temperature, rain, wind, UV, energy and water sensors
toggle a switch automatically when arriving home (geofencing)
trigger devices by scanning NFC tags or QR codes
control smart home switches from an Android Wear watch
view devices laid out on a home floorplan
how_to_run: Download the app from the Google Play Store
notable: Geofencing, NFC/QR code, Bluetooth, beacon and speech triggers for switches
Android Wear support for toggling switches from a watch
caveats: Premium features (geofencing, Android Wear, widgets) require the paid version on the Play Store
Android Auto support is work in progress and not available on the Play Store
Requires a running Domoticz server; the README gives no setup steps for it
